The offer covers stays between 1 November and 15 December 2026,

Buen Hombre gets about twice as many windy days as Cabarete, 
so there's more time on the water and less waiting on the beach.
Pay the $425 deposit by 1 November to hold your spot. We have only 10 places a week."/>
